You can also find a great number of boutiques and a variety of bars and restaurants. The district of Gràcia is home to many students. apartamento de ótima localização.
Es muy buena la ubicaciones. y Francisco nos ayudo mucho y estuvo muy atento a nuestras inquietudes.

el departamento era lo que esperabamos, es pequeño pero perfecto para turistas con todo lo escencial para estar comodos, los conserjes muy amables y nuestro anfitrión muy dispuesto a ayudarnos en todo!
totalmente recomendable ;) :D

Beautiful and very comfortable place. Bright at day and very quiet at night. I was happy about the elevator and not having to carry my heavy suitcase up. I loved the neighbourhood and restaurants around. I went to check out the views on the rooftop too. Only met Nora very briefly, but she seemed very sweet.
great area full of awesome restaurants and cafes! very close to subway and so great with elevator access

This area is not to far from the subway and it is a very quiet neighborhood. Nora is absolutely amazing as well. She is so friendly and will make sure your trip is enjoyable as possible. 10/10 would recommend!

Her place is nice to stay when you travel NYC. I've been 2 different airbnb places in NYC, but her place was the best. Safe enterance, close to subway, warm and cozy room. I'll definately recommend her place if have any chance :)
Muy bueno el edificio y el departamento! Muy buena la ubicación respecto del metro...muy recomendable!

Very cozy, very close to the subway, and near a staggering amount of tasty restaurants. I stayed here for two weeks, and I really enjoyed it. Nora's place is in a great area of the city, and definitely worth looking into if you're wanting to stay in this area.
Beautiful apartment located in a cool area close to many restaurants and touristic places. Highly recommended!

convenient for explore downtown Manhattan, and the apartment has a elevator that make our life easier lol. However, the hair dryer that provided is a European plug- which we didn't have an adapter and there isn't any socket that fit, weird and inconvenient especially when girls have to dry their hair in winter.

Appartement très chaleureux chez Nora. Aucun regret. Il y a deux chambres, parfois Nora est là, parfois en voyage. Nous avons eu une autre chambre quelle celle en photo mais très chaleureuse aussi et nous avons pu rencontrer une super globe-trotteuse à l'occasion de notre voyage. L'appartement est très bien situé, calme et chaleureux. Le roof top est très agréable. Nous recommandons!

Very cozy apartment at Nora. No regrets. There are two rooms, sometimes Nora is there, sometimes traveling. We had a different room than the one in picture but very warm too. We met a super globe-trotting on the occasion of our trip. The apartment is in a great location, quiet and cozy. The roof top is very nice. We recommend!
The place is really clean and warm during the winter. We love how it is close to many tourist attractions that you can visit in NY. Great Chinese food and bars within walking distance.
We find the place nice, convenient and safe. Consider the value of money, I will recommend Nora's place.

Great apartment in a super good location. The lower east is the coolest in NYC (I think). The apartment is near bars, restaurants, brookleen and etc. 
Come!

Nora is an awesome host and her apartment is beautiful.
Great neighborhood, building , apartment and room. The guest bedroom was comfortable and quiet. The bathroom was spotless.

El departamento de Nora es el mejor, muy bien ubicado cerca de una estacion del metro, muy limpio y comodo su apartamento y sobretodo ella muy atenta con cualquier duda estaba al pendiente y siempre nos recomendo muy buenos lugares

This is definetely worth it. The appartment is really bright and really clean. The street is quiet. Everything You need is near by. And the views from the rooftop are amazing. Nora is calm and helpful person. Just perfect.
Pretty decent location.  Not great if you're looking for privacy.  Nora is a very lovely and helpful person, though.
the best location in town

It was our fist time using airbnb and hence my first comments. 
The location is good for exploring Manhattan and NYC, close to two different subway lines,  Some restaurants, bars, shops close by as well as Chinatown and little Italy with its restaurants.
The apartment is located on a small road, so no traffic noise a.s.o.
We stayed abt 10 days, and we have not seen Nora at all. However communication via email etc was good and prompt. The apartment consists of two rooms and a living room, both rooms are being rented out. Fotos show the larger room, ours was about 2/3 of the size for the same price and a bit small for two adults with two suitcases.
The appartment was clean, however a weekly cleaning of the bathroom would be nice, especially if the apartment is completely rented out. Some cutlery and more plates etc would be great as it is quite limited.
For people staying longer, a TV migth be useful, but you may also watch tv via wlan, which is available.
Overall we would come back.
Lovely apartment.  Nora was so easy to deal with - very accommodating.
Great location and a private room that's good if you don't plan to spend much time at the house.
Perfect location for stay some days close to mid-Manhattan and Brooklyn. Nora is a very nice hostess.
Tolle Lage, sehr kleines Zimmer.

Cozy, convenient, clean, and safe location nestled in the LES. Nora was extremely communicative and helped us with any requests! The apartment was clean and neat with functional AC which helped during our stay in the summer!

The location is an 8 minute walk to Grand central station, 20 mins to Brooklyn Bridge, and is in a convenient location if you want to be nestled near Little Italy, CHina Town, and all the other good eats in Eastern Manhattan. The only downside was that the elevator didn't work for 2 of the days we were there, but the flight of stairs going up to the 5th floor isn't that much so it wasn't too much of an issue.
Clean, secure apartment on a quiet street but within easy walking distance a variety of restaurants/bars. A lovely place to rest after exploring the city. Roof deck is shared and has great views.
This was a great base for our New York adventure. Close to the subway, Chinatown, Soho and Little Italy. The aircon was a must for the hot NY summer. Nora responded to all messages very quickly.

It was really good to stay. Clean room with the fine A/C. Well organized kitchen and bathroom. Good location to visit both Brooklyn and Manhattan.   And good host. But the room is not locked. So if you specially care about the privacy, you should consider once again. Other things are really great. Thanks Nora.

Nora's place has a great location! 
It's within walking distance to various restaurants and shops, bars and subway station! 
The apartment was clean and spacious and our room had its own air condition, which was great for the hot summer days. 
Nora is really kind and helps you out if you need anything. 
We would definitely recommend it!
Fantastic place to stay, would recommend to anyone trying to be in the heart of NYC

Emplacement parfait, Nora aide pour la découverte de la ville. J'ai eu quelques problèmes pour accéder au logement, problème réglé au bout d'une heure. Pour la sortie, j'ai eu la possibilité de laisser les bagages jusqu'à 16h. 
Quelques conseils s'imposent:
Un léger ménage pendant le séjour de plus d'une semaine est bienvenu. Je n'ai pas réussi à trouver un aspirateur pour faire moi même. 
La  vaisselle pour manger sur place. Manque des assiettes, couverts, verres etc...
Oreillers trop petits.
En conclusion , très bon emplacement, assez calme. Manque d'intimité et de propreté au niveau du logement à mon goût, la chambre sur la photo ne correspondait aux attentes. Choisir plutôt logement complet pour ceux qui souhaitent plus d'intimité.

I spent wonderful days in NYC bei Nora's department. She was always reachable and ready to help when I needed and the department's atmosphere is very peaceful just how I wanted! Everything was very clean and the bed was the best, super comfy!! Air conditioning in my room worked perfectly!
Nora was a great host. And the LES was a great place to stay. Lively and hip. I'd stay there again.

The room at Nora's place has the morning sun and was big enough for me. The location on the Lower East Side is great. There's also access to two rooftop terraces with great views of the city. The room was clean and I had a great time there with Nora as a great host.
Nothing to say - everything was perfect. Fast respond, clean and nice place and a nice area for shopping, going out.
Great space! The room was incredibly clean, shared bathroom and kitchen were immaculate, and the air conditioning was a lifesaver.

Nora is an amazing Host. We always keep in touch and she was so quicky to answer me.
Her house in an amazing area , I loved it. I felt home.
Apartment is cute, confortable and absolutely you have to visit buildind roof top.
I recomend to other guests. Don't lose the possibility to stay to Nora's house :))))

Centrally located in the lower east side. Within walking distance to some of our favorite coffee shops, donut shops, and delis. Easy to get to any of the bridges on the southern tip of Manhattan. Nora also had some great local suggestions like cafe grumpy and ludlow coffee supply. We absolutely love taking advance of the shared rooftop patio and even met some nice residents. Would highly recommend. We will be back.
Great place,  fairly convenient key pickup and location.  Street parking pretty easy to find.

The location of the flat is very good, there are a lot of bars and restaurants in walking distance, the Lower East Side is an area I can really recommend!
The room seemed smaller than on the pictures shown, the roof top terrace is great and also the fact that there is a lift was a big comfort after a day in New York. Nora is a very placid and quiet host, we felt comfortable using the kitchen and the sofa also when she was in. She also gave us good tips for breakfast.
Public transport is close. The cleanness of the bathroom and kitchen was ok, and one towel for one week was just about enough, we could have done with a change (then again we did not ask for it).
The location  was very good and the subway was near. Nora was nice and kind person. We liked Nora´s place very much.
Nice place. Very convenient to commute around town. :)

Nora`s apartment is a wonderful cosy place, exactly as described. Located near the nicest restaurants/bars. Very clean and quiet, check in easy, communication perfect. Nora is a great host! Highly recommended!!!
This flat is in a good area of Manhattan.

Nice location, two bedroom, may be other guests?  She may not be around, but great on email.  Easy to get around town from multi nearby train stations. Don't expect super clean, not in NYC for this price and location.
Hi ha dues habitacions per llogar; una doble molt gran i l’altre és molt més petita i la calefacció fa molt soroll. Però en les fotografies de l’anunci només surt l’habitació gran.

Apartamento confortável e bem localizado, com excelente acesso ao metrô o que facilita muito a locomoção por toda Manhattan. Encontramos Nora apenas no nosso último dia, mas ela foi muito gentil e atenciosa.

Nora’s place was quiet & clean. The location was great for hitting the main tourist spots—we never traveled more than 20 minutes to get where we were going. Her apartment is near some delicious and famous eats (Katz’s, The Black Tap, The Meatball Shop, Dirty French, and Dudley’s were some personal faves). The room was big enough for two of us but a bit of a tight squeeze which we expected considering we were in New York. If we came back for a weekend we would definitely stay here again
Noras place was lovely and perfect for couples. A bit far from the most common NY attractions but close to public transport so it wasnt a big issue. Recommended :)

Nora was really fast to respond to messages and her places was absolutely amazing. It was really clean and very organized, and the location was also very convenient. The price was great for how convenient it was to get anywhere. I would definitely stay with Nora again if I were to go back to new New York.

Nora’s place was small, quiet, and just what we needed. She kept to herself and was extremely polite. Room did get a little warm, but we just cracked open the window. We had a great stay and if we’re ever back in NYC we would love to stay with Nora again.
这个房子很整洁,使用也很防备｡离地铁站走路不超过10分钟｡所在地区也比较安全,离唐人街近,有很多好处的｡Nora是个很安静的人,对附近很熟悉｡推荐｡

Just what I needed. A simple, clean and quiet place to rest. My plans changed last minute and Nora was very accommodating. I am so glad that her place was available and in the city, close to tons of great restaurants and fun bars.

We didn’t have a great experience here. The room was small and comfortable, but the hospitality was sub-par. The host had strict check-in and out times between 4p and 11am, when the key was actually in a drop box waiting. We weren’t told where to find the key, and had to message multiple times, and then finally call to get those instructions.  She said she sent me a message, but on my end I did not receive anything. When we came back after midnight from seeing a show, the host forgot we were there and locked us out with the indoor chain lock. We stood outside banging on the door and ringing the doorbell until she opened it and said she “forgot.” There wasn’t much said after that except for a goodbye in the morning. The room was fine for the cost and the bed was nice, but it wasn’t welcoming and ended up creating more headache. Would not return.

Such a lovely little apartment and Nora was such a friendly host! She made us feel welcome from when we arrived and nothing was ever too much of a bother :) Her apartment is in such a lovely area of New York and we definitely look forward to returning! Xx
Sharp spot. Nora was super cool, easy going, and flexible.
El alojamiento se encuentra en una ubicación inmejorable, prácticamente no tuvimos que usar el subte. Nora es una mujer muy agradable y tranquila. Muy recomendable su alojamiento!!

La ubicación del departamento es muy buena. Tanto la calefacción como el agua caliente funcionaban muy bien. La cama cómoda aunque el espacio un poco reducido en el cuarto. Nora siempre fue muy amable y dio consejos de lugares para comer y hacer compras. Buena relación precio-calidad.
Check in to Nora’s place was very smooth. The room itself was very clean. Conveniently located. Recommend!

Nice place, window looking onto a lovely street and very comfortable beds. Nora always gave us good advice and information on the restaurants and places around. It was a pleasure to stay at her place!
Muy lindo departamento, nos encanto vivir ahi. Mercaditos cerca y varios lugares accesibles: soho, chinatown, metro
Ótimo apartamento, a localização é perto de comércio, metrô, bares e restaurantes. Muito bom
Rooftop views were really nice. Quiet stay. Lots of fun & food nearby. We are vegan and had many options.

Nora’s apartment was in a perfect location with some really cool bars and restaurants nearby! Nora was very friendly and flexible, allowing us to drop our bags off before the check in time. Great value for money and great spot to explore NYC!
We had a very nice staying at Nora’s place. Very good location, nice appartment and a super friendly Nora! We highly recommend this! :)
Everything was excellent! Thank you Nora!
Nora’s place was the perfect place for my husband & I to spend the night in the city. Affordable, bright, quiet and Nora was very friendly and helpful.
The place nice, quiet, easy to move around.

Nora’s home was clean and cute. She provided helpful tips on places to visit which I appreciated. The bed was also comfy which I loved! One thing definitely worth checking out is the rooftop view which was absolutely breathtaking. This home is definitely a gem in LES.

Convenient location, many subway stations, restaurants and other shops at your doorstep. Both Wall Street and Brooklyn Bridge are within walking distance.
The flat is fairly new and well equipped, also has a rooftop with a nice view over the city.
Nora was a great and helpful host, we had a wonderful time and would stay at her place again.
This was a great place! Checking in and out was a breeze and the location was convenient.
Everything was great at Nora’s place, very clean, quiet, and the neighborhood is quite colourfull. All in all a great experience :)
Nora's place is great. The room and private bathroom are nice. Super comfy bed. Great neighborhood. Loved the rooftop views.

Pretty much everything went as we expected and there were no surprises which is a good thing
The house is very well renovated and decorated. AC works great. Overall the place was clean and tidy. 
The immediate blocks surrounding the house belong to Chinatown and lower east village which is not the nicest part of the town, but it's secure. It's also close to little Italy and SOHO which are good for shopping, eating, taking photos, etc.
Thanks Nora for hosting us :)

This was our first Airbnb experience and it was great! Loved the rooftop experience and there was a lot to do near by or a subway ride away! Nora was available and offered help or advise! Very happy with our stay!

Thank you, Nora for opening your fabulous apartment to us while we traveled through. The room was clean, thoughtful, and very private as we never actually met. The rooftop was an amazing little area as well! 100 stars for this little gem!
Nice place and Nora made it very easy. Thank you so much.
Attentive  host, responds quickly, cute apartment, lovely rooftop patio, good suggestions. Nora is a very lovely person.
I had a lovely stay in Nora's place. It's a great apartment for exploring the city. My favorite part was the rooftop. It offers a magnificent view over the city.

Très bonne localisation, beaucoup de petits commerces et restaurants, situé dans chinatown. Nora est très gentille et très agréable, nous recommandons ce lieu. Néanmoins nous n'avons pas utilisé les parties communes juste la chambre avec une salle de bain privée.

My stay at Nora's place, I will break it down to pros and cons.
Pros:
- the location is close to great restaurant, subway station, and 20 min. from the major attractions.

Cons:
- not all of the rooms have a queen beds, depending on the room you get (it was not communicated at the time of my booking)
- private rooms don't have locks
- cleanliness
I would confirm all of the above mention details during you booking.
Great location, Nora is very helpful.  Place is clean and bright, just as advertised.  We'd stay again!
no frills room/bath in a great location, we did not use the roof top as we were too busy exploring the city the 2 days/nights we were there

Location of the apartment is amazing. It's next to so many cool spots and it's a walkable distance to Wall Street. Best thing is, there are so many authentic and cheap Chinese diners just around the corner.
Bedroom is a little bit small for 2 persons, but since we spent most of the time in the city, so it was quite ok.  
I will definitely recommend this place.
Thank you very much Nora :)

A well situated and very clean appartment in the lower east side. We enjoyed the good public transport nearby (subway F and SBS-Bus No 15), so we arrived all major sights within 20 min. Nora is a very welcoming host. Although we did not meet in person, all communication went perfect, quick and accurate via Airbnb-Mails. Very helpful was for us that Nora prepared a list with good possibilities to go out in the quarter. All in all we  enjoyed completly our 11 nights stay there.

Nora was kind and communicative, but the apartment was in not-the-nicest area, a lot of the house was not quite clean (kind of grimy), and the bed felt like a layer of foam over plywood.  We definitely felt safe inside the house, but it was quite an unpleasant stay.

Nora‘s apartment is located in NYC‘s South-East in Manhattan/Chinatown. There are two very close Metro stations: East Broadway and Delancey Station/Essex Street. Both stations offer a great connection to every desired destination. 
It also only takes 5 to 10 minutes by foot to get a great view of the Manhattan Bridge, East River and Brooklyn’s coast.

FALSE ADVERTISING: All the host's listings are advertised as "entire apartment" or "entire loft", however this is not true. The listings are micro-sized rooms inside an existing apartment that has been converted into a hostel like setup, except the host also lives inside the apartment. There is no expectation of privacy. Whenever you come and go, you will interact with one of the hosts. If you leave the apartment before 9am, you will need to PHYSICALLY CLIMB over a sleeping host as their bed is placed directly in the hallway, blocking entries and exits (fire hazard?). This is also true if you come back to the apartment after 1am. Additionally, the host will enter your room EVERYDAY while you are gone and re-arrange your items. There is no do-not-disturb notice that you can place on your door. The most egregious breech of privacy was one day I slept in, and both hosts knocked on my door, physically entered the room, switched on the light and visually examined the room for no reason whatsoever. The host(s) do not speak any English. I do not recommend this listing unless you are fully aware of what you are getting into. For what it's worth, it was a unique cultural experience.

The positives to the apartment is the central Mong Kok location, but ~$40 a night seems to be a more reasonable price than $57+

Frank's place was very nice and a very good location. the doormen were all great. the place is in a beautiful part of copacabana beach. great view!!. the only negative was that there is no actual "hot tub", as it does not have a heater. Other than that everything was great!!

Perfect location!  The doormen were very friendly but none spoke any English or Spanish.  Definitely learn some basic Portuguese phrases before staying here.  There are grocery stores two blocks down Rua Bolivar away from the beach.  Money exchange is also two blocks down Avenida Atlantica.

We spent Christmas in the Penthouse at Copacabana Beach.  This property is perfectly situated; overlooks the Beach, access to many great restaurants, a block from the supermarket and in a safe area. All'arrivo in casa non c'era nessuno ad accoglierci, abbiamo avuto difficoltà a trovare l'appartamento in quanto nessuno ci aveva detto che dall'ultimo piano raggiungibile con l'ascensore dovevamo ancora salire un piano a piedi.

The apartment is very well located in Copacabana on the seafront From the 12th floor, the view is spectacular : from Sugar Loaf to the Fort Copacabana.
Its location in the city is perfect for visiting all the interests.
The building is a bit old as many in Copabana but is maintained. The apartment has undergone renovations that remain to be completed.
The air conditioning works well and the pool is very nice.
 2 bathrooms and kitchen have been remodeled.
We may regret the absence of a mixer on showers and of a dishwasher. The curtains are not blackout and should be changed.
The lighting in the rooms is impractical. Despite a sum of details that should be resolved shortly, it is very nice to stay in the apartment.

The penthouse is located in a great spot in front of Copacabana beach with great view from every room. Although if i chose to visit Rio one more time, i would definitely choose Leblon to stay because of the proximity to all nice bars and restaurants. The neighbourhood is safe in general and we encountered no bad surprises! 
Pros: Frank and his team are really easy to find and very helpful. They provided everything we asked or at least they tried. The doormen are 24/7 and very helpful!
Cons: The apartment though had some issues. Firstly the jets don't work properly at the hot tub so its more like a small pool. One of two safes and the microwave were out of order. We had some difficulties to fix the right temperature of the water in the showers as well. When we visited there was noise coming from the renovation of the apartment just underneath ours so we had to wake up at 8 every day except weekends. Overall it was a satisfying experience.

Elisa and Frank were easy to get a hold of when our group of six had questions. Pros: Location, location, location! It's awesome and right on the beach with tons of places to eat and drink right around the corner! We were granted an early check-in and a late-check out. The view of the beach is fantastic and the lighting in the apartment is reminiscent of The Max from Saved By the Bell! Elisa, who helps you get the keys and communicates with you when you arrive in Rio, is welcoming and always reachable by (Hidden by Airbnb) . The doorman, Simão, is delightful and super friendly. We miss him already! 
Cons: This is advertised as a five star penthouse, however, we think it is more of a three star. Our group is all good with a three star, no problems...we have all stayed at a many Motel 6 before and hostels, but the advertising was not quite accurate. The space does not have the same furniture as pictured in the living room. We had previously contacted Frank about the "pool" because we saw prior guests write that it was not working. Frank assured us that it was, however, it did not work. Ivo, a maintenance man, came by twice to help and ultimately, it never worked. We felt bad, as it was not Ivo's fault and he also came by later because the second bathroom did not have hot water. Overall, we had a lovely time exploring Rio and we would have appreciated an honest representation of this space.

Sehr freundliche Betreuung. Perfekte Lage an der Copacabana. Das Penthouse war schön gross und gemütllich. Die Farbe vom Whirlpool blätterte ab und verstopfte den Abfluss. Lange Rede kürzer Sinn, dass Penthaouse ist zu empfhlen.

There was a problem with this place we booked a few days before we arrived, so we were relocated to a different apartment in Rio. We stayed three nights at Kev's place with our two small kids (ages 3 and 1). It worked out well for us: we put the kids in the two bedrooms so that we could use the rest of the place (living room, kitchen, and bathroom) after they went to bed. The bed in the main bedroom is quite comfortable, and the fold-out bed in the living room is decent. The air mattress is an air mattress, but our 3-year-old was fine with it :)

Kev's place exactly matches his description and photos. It's pretty spacious for Manhattan, with great light coming in through the 4 large windows in the living room. Apart from the furniture it's fairly bare-bones: you've got all the essentials in the kitchen and bathroom, but not much else (no tissues, for example), so it doesn't feel as much like a "home" as some other places we've stayed. But we had everything we needed and enjoyed eating in for dinner as a family.  It was a nice, clean, comfortable place to stay for three days.

The neighborhood is great: tons of great shops/restaurants all around you, and a quick walk to the subway, Morningside Park (including multiple great playgrounds for the kids), and Central Park.  The street has moderate noise from buses, trucks, and the occasional siren, but it's pretty muffled in the bedrooms.  We had our car with us and had good luck finding parking on the surrounding side streets.

Kev was communicative and check-in/check-out were smooth.
We loved the set-up and decor. Kitchen was big enough for us to cook comfortably. Everything worked well besides the washing machine/dryer. Not too noisy. The stairways were lacking in cleanliness.

I'm a little biased because I used to live here, but this is one of my favorite neighborhoods in new york. It has great access to bus and subways, and is even reasonably walkable to the museums on the UES and UWS.
Kev's apartment was exactly as presented and perfect for a weekend trip. As mentioned by other visitors, the bed was super comfy. I'd recommend this place to my own friends and family.
Très bonne location, bien placée, sympa. Seul bémol, la deuxième chambre n'est pas équipée d'un vrai lit ce qui oblige à dormir dans le canapé lit du salon.

Kev's place is very convenient if you want to be in that area.  Easy access to public transportation, parks, and Columbia U.  Apartment was clean and had all the basic items you'd expect.  I would definitely stay there again.

We loved this place! It's definitely a great value. Totally renovated, high ceilings, tall windows, wood floors. Tastefully done with an urban, minimilast feel. Spacious for a city apartment. Loved the location too. Had fun checking out eateries on Frederick Douglass Blvd (recommend Lidos and Cafe Frederick), enjoyed Morningside Park, caught a 
show at the Apollo, and easily got around with Uber and the subway. Kev was helpful and responsive. We highly recommend it!
very nice renovated apartment in a cool and safe part of Harlem, excellent communication and host friendly
The place was clean and roomy. It was great for the price.

O espaço de Kev é maravilhoso, muito limpo e espaçoso. Adorei a decoração, a qualidade da roupa de cama e banho. Excelente estadia. O bairro é bem residencial e familiar. Foi uma estadia agradável. Kev foi muito atencioso conosco, recomendo o espaço do Kev a todos os integrantes do Airbnb.
Friendly and nice, more attention to cleaning.

The size of apt is very good. Just like on photos. Communications was easy and no problem. Kev was a good host. Everything was good except small food roaches in the kitchen. I hate it. Thats why we couldnt cook and eat there and tried to avoid kitchen at all. I know it's New York and probably its a common problem but still that was the only downside. If you're ok with it, its a good choice.

About the Host:
Kev is a great host,  he is friendly, informing and understanding.  You won't run into any trouble with him.

About the place:
The place is very well located if you are going to be most of the time in Manhattan. You will be 20 to 30 minutes away by metro to most of NYCs tourism hotspots.

The place is in a very convenient location in Harlem close to the 116th and 125th subway stations. It is very comfortable and large for New York standers and looks like it has been renovated recently.
The common areas of the building could be improved and cleaner,  but that does not detract from the experience once you are in the apartment .
The communication with the host was very good. The check in and check out were easy . I will definitely come back next time I am New York.

I stayed at Kev's place for a visit to Columbia University. It is within walking distance, or a short cab ride. The apartment is very spacious, can easily host 4 people, and probably a few more. Clean and comfortable. I didnt get to meet Kev, but communication was smooth. The key could be picked up from a dropbox around the corner. Neighborhood is fine, although at night I preferred a cab over a walk.

Rare find in NYC, an apartment with windows on 3 sides!  I spent an entire week here, mostly inside of the apartment due to a work project.  I loved sitting in the window sills and watching people walk by, and the fact that there was a grocery store coffee shop and metro station just a block and a half away.  Perfect location and floor plan.
不错的体验,在117街和曼哈顿街交汇口,交通方便,公寓内部不错,入口处和楼梯稍旧,房东很nice!该有的生活用品都齐全｡

Superbe appartement tout confort, rue très tranquille, très proche du métro et des bus et pas trop éloigné des musées. Un vrai plaisir. Kev était présent à notre arrivée et nous a donné les indications nécessaires.

I recomend this apartment for a stay in NYC. Close to the subway and some good restaurants.
The apartment is in a quiet neigbourhood. It is well maintained and well kept.

We really enjoyed Kevin's place in Morningside Heights. Chose this area to minimize driving in NYC, but easy to get around via subway and that worked out great. Very quiet street and was able to find on street parking fairly easily for all 3 nights (street cleaning rules require you to move it every couple of days). Two subway lines located within a few blocks. Quiet neighborhood, but neighbors hanging out on the stoops give it a nice and safe vibe. Check out 116th street around the corner and all the African restaurants and stores! Would definitely stay at Kevin's again.

Kevin was informative and his place was exactly as presented. In a really good location and we went to one of his recommended places (st. John the divine's cathedral) and it was great.

Would definitely stay again.
The apartment is large and sunny. The neighborhood is mostly quiet, close to the subway and Columbia/Barnard, and elegant. Kev was very easy to work with.
This place is immaculate, quiet and a great location.super easy to get around from here thx to proximity of subways....lots of good food within 15 min walk. Great value
Kev's place was in close proximity to the subway. Everything we needed was in the apartment. Had a great stay and would stay again.

Super appartement, propre,  300 mètres du metro et commerces,  quartier sans problème
20 minutes en metro de Times Square et 500 metres de central Park Nord et Harlem

I stayed at Kev's place for 1 week with wife and 5yo daughter and it has been absolutely great! The apartment is very nice and comfortable and equipped with all you need and Kev keeps it very clean and in great general conditions. Everything went incredibly smooth: super easy arrangements for keys pickup and drop and Kev has always been available and quick to reply for any questions. Highly recommended!!

We were visiting my brother who lives nearby, so Kev's place worked out perfectly. The apartment was more than enough for my wife and I, but you could probably fit up to 4 people in there, no problem. Apartment was clean, Kev was friendly and accessible and the location was perfect. If you're looking for a place to stay while visiting New York, I highly recommend staying here. We'll definitely be back.

Kevin was very accommodating and utilized great communication skills. When we arrived we found a clean, warm apartment with a candle glowing in the bathroom! The apartment is very well located, just a short walk to the bus, subway, Central park and Morningside park.

My partner and I departed from California and arrived in New York around 10am. Our check-in time was around noon. We asked Kevin ahead of time if he can accommodate us by letting us drop off our luggage before checking in and he was okay with it. He really saved us the hassle finding a place/storage for our luggage. The airbnb is located next to a subway which made traveling very easy to do. Also, there were a lot of Deli's around for a quick bite if you don't want to cook. The airbnb is clean and very simple yet nice looking. Kevin is a really nice guy. Kevin gave us local tips which made our traveling easy and fun. You won't be disappointed. Thank you Kevin !

The host is very accommodating and has great communication! This is a great place very close to public transit. It was nice not being in the middle of downtown craziness but still  close enough to visit if you wanted to. The place is clean and comfortable and the directions and communication were very clear.
I think Kev should hire a professional photographer. This home is much nicer than the photos showed! The location is great, and the street is quiet. Everything is excellent!

My trip was cancelled due to extreme weather, but all my dealings with Kev were wonderful: he’s thoughtful, kind, was responsive quickly to all enquirers, and so understanding when things fell through. Can’t wait to try this stay again!!

Kevin's apartment is amazing, spacious, clean and in a great location. It has everything you'll need if you're cooking, and the temperature is pretty easy to adjust if need be. Kevin is also incredibly accommodating and kind! Highly recommended.
The host canceled this reservation 4 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Appartement très bien situé à 3 minutes du métro qui amène en 15 minutes dans le centre de Manhattan. Commerces à proximité. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour. Appartement très fonctionnel. Kevin est dispo si besoin. Vraiment top.
Kev was an awesome host. Very flexible. The space was great. I would definitely stay there again
The condo is very clean and confortable. Thank you

Kevin was an amazing host and so understanding. The apartment was great! At night you hear a whole lot of nightlife but with the bose speaker he has there it tunes them out. Thank you again Kevin for making my visit even better than I thought!

The apartment was good, spacious enough for 4 people.  There are alot of stairs in the building to get to the apartment so if you have alot of  luggage it may be a problem for some people.  The stairwell to the apartment was not very clean but the apartment was fine.  The area is very safe to walk around at night with some great restaurants & nightlife. Close to subway.

Appartement très spacieux . La présence du WIFI est incontestablement utile pour le voyageur qui veut préparer ses visites de la journée, et maintenir le contact avec la Famille.

Nous avions le plein usage des locaux , et avons beaucoup apprécié. 
Nous recommandons cette solution de logement
Great place to stay. Kiev was very helpful and flexible with check in times. The bed was comfortable.

Great space, open living room/dining area. Big beautiful windows if you’re a fan of natural light. Minute walk from the subway. Check out Silvana on 116th, truly delicious North African/Middle Eastern food.
Solid place!!!

Kev's place was awesome. The pictures he provides make the place look great, and it is even better in person. You won't find a nicer place to stay for the value on Manhattan. It is two blocks from the local train and five from the express train, so you can get anywhere in the city quickly and easily. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for somewhere to stay in the city!

Kevin was a great host.  He replied very quickly to any questions (before and during our stay).  Provided tips for local attractions, grocery stores, etc.  Condo was convenient to a few train stations.  Overall, we had a very enjoyable trip to NYC.
Kiev’s place is great. We stayed for 3 nights with our two kids. Lovely open space, v comfortable
Awesome location, great place. Kev is an great host.
Excellent place to stay with great location. Clean, comfortable, and convenient! We hope to return at another date. Kev was very responsive and helpful.

We had such a great stay! The condo is really close to the subway station and there are a lot of great places very close by! Everything looked as in the pictures. We also found a parking spot just in front of the door for all weekend! I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone coming to NY. The only thing I would have liked to know is that the best way to communicate with Kev is by texts (or What'sapp) instead of going through Airbnb.
Great apartment and great location.
Kev was a good host and it was a pleasure to stay at his apartment. Thanks, it made our trip to New York great!

Kev's place was great, very clean and a good size with a well stocked kitchen. It was in a nice area with multiple subway stations within 5 minute walks, also just a short walk to Central Park. Kev was very responsive and clear with messages. Would recommend!
The flat was very clean and near to subway! Perfect to visit NY

Kev ist ein super Gastgeber, der über Whats app auch immer erreichbar ist. Die Wohnung ist sauber,ausreichend groß, hat eine gute Lage und ist nur wenige Meter von der Subway entfernt. Diese Unterkunft ist auf jeden Fall zu empfehlen.

Kevin was a great host. The check in and check out process was quick and simple. The apartment had all the amenities we needed. My parents were in town for my graduation and they also loved the apartments decor and the space.
Amazing place! Very spacious, the apartment has great natural lightening. The bed was very comfortable to sleep on. Kevin was a great host. Definitely recommend
Great place! Really close to the subway and not far from Central Park! Great stay for a few days! Would definitely stay again. Thanks Kevin!!
Great location, easy communication with the host.  Highly recommend!

Kev was an amazing host - easy to get in touch with. The accommodation was exactly as shown in the photos. Location was great - close to shopping and transit.  Would recommend Kev's place to a friend.
It’s a great space.  Very convenient to the subway, good shops for groceries or wine.  Enormous towels.  Having 2 bedrooms is really nice.
This place is a superfecta: excellent location, easy access, quality accommodation, and great food & amenity options nearby!

Kev’s place is very close to subway with minimal walking, decent neighborhood and it is easy to get in touch with him as well (quick response time). The apartment is very clean and nicely updated. Enough space for 3+ people to sleep comfortably. The air conditioner kept the place nice and cool for the hot weekend!! Finding the hot water in the shower was tricky at first but once you figure it out you know it works! I’d definitely recommend this place and use it again!  Thanks for letting us stay!
Great place. Kev was awesome and attentive in communication.
Good deal. Clean, affordable and in a decent location
This was the second time I stayed at Kev's place and both times were great. Fantastic location, excellent space, and very comfortable and clean.

Kevin's apartment was very nice and spacious especially for New York city standards. I appreciated how he let us check-in early since our bus arrived early. Located conveniently near the subway station in a nice neighborhood where we enjoyed the local restaurants. My friends and I loved the apartment and all the amenities he provided that made us us feel at home.
Great place to stay and will plan on staying there again on a return trip!
Great place to stay in NY! Quiet area at night, super super spacious apartment, and enough space for people to sleep. Thanks Kev for a great stay!
Great communication by Kev
Great location, great communication from Kevin!
Great location near lots of good eats and public transportation. Kevin was prompt with responses. Would stay here again.
Great location, prompt responses from Kev, and tons of space. The price was a super value, and it was very close to the subway.
Great apartment, very comfortable, clean and excellent location.
Nice condo in Harlem.  very close to the subway.  Communication was painless.
Close to Colombia, central park north and several subway stations so convenient to get to where we needed to go. Kev was very responsive and accommodating to whatever came up.
great place! It was very easy to get in touch with Kev. And location is amazing for the price

Very spacious place in an up and coming neighborhood. Easy access to Columbia University and quick subway ride to midtown. Kev met me in person and was a very responsive host. Overall experience was positive.

The place was not ready at the stated check in time (1.5h delay), some parts were dirty (hasn't been dusted in a while, shower curtain was quite dirty, etc). Washer/dryer did not work properly, although Kev did warn me that there might be issues

Great space and great location! Kevin was an awesome host and made sure to communicate prior to our travel so we didn’t have any trouble getting from the airport to the air b&b. He made himself available easily by text and phone. He also kept his space clean and accommodating. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would do it again.

Kev’s place was more than we expected. It was great to have a full apartment to stay in, verses the hotels we normally stay at.  The bed was comfortable and we slept great. Only issue was finding the sweet spot for hot water/water pressure in the shower. Check in/out was easy. It is on the third floor, so careful with how many bags you have to carry up and down.

My husband and I stayed at Kev's place for a short trip. It was a great location and price. Super close to 2 different subways. Kev was always easy to communicate with and the check-in/check-out was great. Would recommend staying here for up to 4 people! A great place to get the best of Manhattan.
Clean, well kept two bedroom apartment in a great location. Kev was a great host, very prompt, good communication.
Kev's place was in a good location with lots of local food and entertainment.  Kev was very response to any questions.
Good host. Not sure how safe neighbourhood was at night, we didn’t go out at night. Easy checkin

Location is perfect. It is close to the subway that runs along 8th Avenue, giving easy access to the whole of Manhattan. There are excellent restaurants within mere feet of the apartment. Central Park and Columbia are within walking distance. There were some maintenance issues as it is an older building but Kev offered solutions and quick responses to these issue. Kev made check-in easy and provided excellent communication and information.
good location and nice and cosy appartment

Kevin was a very good host and met me at the apartment to show me around and give me the keys. He was very gracious and even allowed me to drop off my bags early and officially check in later. 
On the first night, which was quite cold, I experienced a notorious New York loss of heat. I alerted him in the morning and he came to help and determined the cause was a building wide boiler shutdown. He was very attentive to the issue and purchased space heaters for a temporary solution. 
The apartment was in a convenient location for upper west side locales and close to subway stations and bus lines. It is a short walk to the cathedral and Central Park and many good restaurants and shops 
There was plenty of space for 2 or more guests with 2 bedrooms and a pullout sofa in the living room. It had a decent sized kitchen for cooking meals if one chose to. 
The only down side is it is on the third floor of a brownstone (without an elevator) so I would take that into consideration when booking if not traveling light or one has an inability to climb stairs. 
All in all, it was a good experience and I would stay there again.
Great location and Kevin was a great host.  Very roomy space for Manhattan.  We would definitely stay again!

Sheila and Manny are the types of hosts who make you not only feel at home, but also like family - from inviting us to their local pub with their delightful friends, to having a meal at what must be one of the most authentic Chinese restaurants, not to speak about introducing us to Rocco's which must have the best canneloni outside Italy :)
A wonderful spot for those who want to be part of New York life and still have a peaceful place to retire to at night :) The apartment is exactly like on the pictures - charming, newly renovated, clean and well-equipped. 
It is in a lively neighbourhood with a great cafe for brunch (Cafe Orlin), jazz and good French food (Jules Jazz bar) and some of the best pizza slices right on the corner at Stromboli. There are also some amazing little shops and parks in the area. The perfect location in all aspects. 
We loved it and we will be back!

Spend a very very nice time by Sheila and Manny. The studio was exactly has expected and advertised. I've been travelling with my wife and our 20 months old daughter. The location was perfect for us. Quiet studio in the middle of East Village. Just a few minutes away from the subway station and Greewich village. Everything needed was available in the studio: wifi, kitchen, washing machine, dryer, ... Sheila and Manny were really helpful at all time. We will definitely stay again there during our next stay in NYC.

Shelia was great! My parents came to NY for the second time and stayed at Shelia's place on St. Marks Street. The place was so cute and very clean. There was a lovely little outdoor space and my parents couldn't stop raving about the apartment. Sheila was so accommodating and was there to answer any and all questions any time my folks had any. Thank you Shelia for making their stay in the city so stress-free and wonderful!

The stay at Sheila and Manny's was great! They are very thoughtful hosts and provided everything we needed, including necessitites, information and a most warm welcome. The apartment is large (we stayed there with four people in the large main room and didn't mind a small bathroom) and cozy and equipped with everything you could wish for, including coffee maker, washing machine, a large gas stove etc. It is located in the centre of the vibrating East Village with its many restaurants and bars. The apartment is in the back so you hardly notice the bustle outside. It has a small backyard where you can sit outside to have breakfast before walking around Manhattan or taking the Subway (which is very close). We will love to come back and highly recommend staying there!

Sheila and Manny were the best hosts we could have imagined. The apartment is perfect and roomy with its own private entrance and access to an outdoor patio (grill and all.) They have thought of everything you could possibly need including a full list of food, coffee, and sites worth checking out. The location was even better than I thought as we were a matter of blocks from most of our main NYC food destinations and merely and hop and a skip from everything else you could possibly want to do. 

We had the pleasure of meeting Sheila for a round at her local watering hole and highly suggest to pop by to meet all of her neighbors and friends! These two hosts have really made a home for themselves in their neighborhood and welcomed us with open arms. 

You have to stay at this St Marks gem!  Unfortunately for any other prospective hosts in this city, we will always have Sheila's studio as our first choice. My only regret is that we couldn't stay longer, but we will be back soon. 

-Shannon and David

What a perfect place to spend some great days in New York City! 

Sheila and Manny are very welcoming, helpful, and generous hosts. We really enjoyed staying in their charming studio, which is clean, cozy, and very well organized. It is also very conveniently located in East Village, which made it easy for us to get to our destination during our NYC trip. Sheila is extremely responsive, and I highly recommend her as a host. We went out one evening together in her favorite bar just around the corner and met some of her friends. It was such a nice evening. Thanks, Sheila! We strongly recommend this studio and we certainly would like to be hosted there again. Hope to see you soon!!

The Apartment, neighborhood and Hosts were so much more than we expected, everything was perfect. I will never stay anywhere else when I come to New York from now on. Our hosts Sheila an Manny are wonderful.

Staying at Sheila`s was awesome, great place, amazing location. My friends and I were mostly out all day, so we didnt hang with Sheila, but she was always aware that we were ok and having a great time. I dont have words to thank yo Sheila!

Gracias!
This was,by far, the best location we have ever stayed at. It was everything it was advertised to be and the hosts, Sheila and Manny, were the warmest, most welcoming hosts anyone could hope for.

We really enjoyed staying at Sheila's. She was a gracious host and the apt. was super nice with everything we needed plus more. We only wish we could have stayed longer. Sheila and Manny were generous and kind and it was great fun meeting them. I will definitely come again given the opportunity.

Sheila and her family have been the best hosts that we could imagine. The apartment is like you can see in the pictures and it has all you need. The neighbourhood has a lot of shops, restaurants and the subway is very close and you can go everywhere.The best way to live NYC. Thanks Sheila & manny for your hospitality. The apartment and the location were outstanding!  It's in a fun neighborhood, but it's extremely quiet in the apartment at the same time.  I definitely recommend it!

Shelia apartment was more than what we expected. She also had plenty umbrellas handy which were needed on our trip. I stayed at the apartment with my two cousins and a friend and we were comfortable in the apartment. More importantly, one of my cousins had a sudden accident and was in a wheel chair during our stay. This is a huge plus because we were worried she would have a lot of trouble getting around but it was no hassle at all. The apartment itself is very clean and modern. Honestly, our experience was amazing and I am so glad that we had the opportunity to stay in Shelia's apartment.

Had a great time at Sheila's place in the East Village. The location was fabulous, just step out and you are there! The studio was new and clean and had everything you may want to make it like home.  Had a great time!

Sheila and Manny were great hosts in every way.  Met us and briefed us on the place and offered much information about events in the area.  The roomy ground floor apartment has dishwasher, washer/dryer, and all the kitchen appliances you'd need, including our favorite Keurig coffee maker.  Closet space, beautiful floors, stylish modern furniture, and a bed to gladden the heart of the traveler.  This block of St. Mark's Place is peaceful enough during the days, and the area around it throbs with activity especially on weekend evenings.  Classic Lower East Side digs and exceptional hosts.

Merci Sheila pour votre accueil.Votre appartement était propre,bien équipé, au calme dans un quartier très vivant.Nous espérons avoir la chance de pouvoir y revenir!Nous avons passé une très bonne semaine.A bientot.Cathy et Olivier

Sheila et Manny sont très sympathiques et accueillants, il s'agit d'un vrai BnB et les hôtes sont attendus et bien reçus.

Thanks again Sheila for everything you really helped us out
