We were impressed with the stylish quaintness of Paula’s studio apartment.  The location could not be better for walking to restaurants, tourist attractions and getting to the airport.  The studio was spotlessly clean with a comfortable queen bed, a small well-equipped kitchen, and small balcony to sit in the warm afternoon sun.  The laundry mat is less a block away which was very convenient for us.  We would highly recommend Paula’s Studio to anyone who can appreciate a clean and well-appointed place.
central, a little bit noisy outside but super stay in porto

Chambre lumineuse et bien située.
Décoration intérieure sympa.
Petit bémol sur l'isolation phonique mais cela reste une location que je recommande. J'y reviendrais avec plaisir !

Paula’s place was perfect for our stay in Porto.
A great location for access to the major attractions and for some really good restaurants.
The apartment was clean and modern, just right for 2 people.
The bed was comfortable and the shower was hot.
We would not hesitate to stay again in this great little apartment.

Perfect location. Free onsite parking a bonus. Nearby laundry and supermarket. Shopping malls and pedestrian paths full of great places to eat. Short walk to all the main sites of Porto. Don’t think there could be a more perfect location - tasteful modernisation of a beautiful old building. We would definitely stay here again.

Helles und sehr sauberes Doppelzimmer. Sehr gutes Bett mit richtig guten Kissen und alles duftig frisch.
Die Fenster sind Schallschutzfenster, sodaß der Strassenlärm tatsächlich nicht mehr hörbar ist. Innerhalb des Hauses recht hellhörig.
Ich würde das Zimmer nochmal buchen.

Paula has the cutest little space which was walkable and close to everything!Our communication with Paula was good and getting to the apartment with her instructions was very easy. The apartment was modern, clean and very comfortable - perfect for couples. The Chavez Cafe down the street was a definite highlight. We had a really great time - I would definitely recommend to anyone travelling to Porto!

We hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad in Paula's appartement, heerlijk bed en een fijne douche. Ook ligt alles lekker dichtbij, de brug en rivier waren zo'n 10 minuten lopen en veel eettentjes in de buurt. Zouden hier zeker nog eens verblijven!

Paula's place is located just behind Rua St. Catarina. As that, you will find everything near by, from groceries to local restaurants, shopping mall and all kind of shops. 20mins walk and you will be at Ribeira. What else can you ask for? The place itself is stylish, with an awesome bed (never slept in a better mattress on a Airbnb), well equipped, with everything you need. The check in was very flexible and the communication was easy and fast. Highly recommended.
Great location, easy to find, very clean and comfortable place. Highly recommended

Die Unterkunft ist klein aber fein. Für ein paar Tage für ein Pärchen super geeignet. Obwohl die Wohnung so zentral liegt hat man nichts vom Straßenlärm gehört. Das einzige was man bemängeln könnte ist das der Flur sehr hellhörig. Aber wir kommen gerne wieder.
깨끗하고 좋음

Excellent location. Walking to main pedestrian shopping street. Excellent artinsenal craft beer  spot with huge back garden a few doors down. Modern clean studio apartment. Has great parking for cheap behind.
 Coffee maker is just a Nespresso btw. But coffee and pastry shops within the block.
Very nice Place with warm welcome. I highly recommand this Place!
At 3 min from the close by Bolhão metro station (direct from/to airport) it's a cosy place with a balcony, ideal for short stay in Porto !

Excellent AirBnB!
The apartment was in an excellent location, close to everything you need. Coming from the airport with my big suitcase was so easy!
The apartment was clean and it was very pleasant to sit on the little balcony.
What a great place.....!  Loved it, would go back in a heartbeat!

Great location and close to everything, including metro and bus stops. Very convenient to get to from the airport. The apartment is super nice, with a comfortable mattress and pillows. The check-in was fast, and Paula left a complimentary mini bottle of port wine and a city map for us.
Really Nice Appartement in the middle of the center.

We really enjoyed our stay at Paula’s flat in fabulous Porto - fantastic location, really comfortable bed, great shower and lovely balcony that got the afternoon/evening sun :) Paula was incredibly helpful and communication was quick and easy leading up to our stay. Her friend Mario let us in and gave us some great tips for seeing the city. We’d highly recommend staying here!
El apartamento H es cómodo, limpio y bien situado
This is a very nice little flat with a perfect location and finished to a high standard (everything you need). Also parking very close to the apartment.
Bel l’appartamento luminoso e centrale. Comodo il parcheggio ma strano richiederne il pagamento a parte, quando è una pertinenza dell’alloggio. Nel complesso un buon soggiorno.
Paula's apartment is a nice apartment perfectly located close to the centre of Porto. Moreover, she is a very helpful host

Paulas appartement was very nice, comfy and absolutely clean. We really enjoyed this place in Porto. Car parking behind the house. We  would like to come back next time. Thank you for your quick calls.

Paula's flat was great for our trip to Porto. After a very delayed flight we arrived at 1 am and Paula's mother was there to meet us and help us check in. Communication was great throughout the process. The flat was clean, cozy and close to sights and amenities. Would definitely recommend.

Paula's place was a good place to stay for a couple days in Porto.  Check in was easy and the map she gave us was very convenient for us to use. It was about a 10 minute walk to any attraction you wanted to check out, but that was the only (slight) downside to the apartment. We really enjoyed sitting in the balcony after a long day of walking around the city.
Great place in the heart of Gracia. Can't go wrong with this one.

The location is amazing! The apartment is pretty noisy because its an old building, we could hear everything that was going in the hallway. Besides that the apartment has everything you need for a few days and it was nice and tidy.

Paula's apartment is exactly as described. It's a cute studio apartment with a small kitchenette and nice balcony to sit on. There's no a/c, but it got cool enough at night that it wasn't a problem at all. However, it is noisy in the area for leaving the windows open. The seagulls are especially loud early in the morning. The location is excellent and easy to walk to the sites of Porto. We used the parking, which was easy though a tight squeeze getting into the garage area. Paula very kindly also left a little bottle of port and a city map as a welcome gift, which was lovely!

Mario and Stephanie showed us the nice apartment. They were really friendly and gave us great tips. Everything was fine in the room and we enjoyed our stay here. We would definitely come back and recommend this place.

Paula’s apartment was lovely. The location was perfect- three minute walk from the metro with easy access to the main train station (we came in from Lisbon) and the airport metro (we went to pick up a car there after our stay).  Everything was clean and her friend Mario was flexible to meet us when our train from Lisbon arrived an hour later than we expected. His recommendations were on point as well!

This is a great apartment to visit Porto. It is well located to visit all that Porto has to offer and very accessible via metro from the airport. if you arrive by train, use Cabify and you will be there under 5 euros. They are some stairs from the main entrance but very easy and not too many. Bed is very confortable, the shower has good water pressure. It has a small kitchen but we didn’t use it since it has so many cafes close by. Communication with Paula is excellent, she responds very quickly and if she can’t be there as it was in our case she ensures that someone will be there.

Paula’s place is lovely, located just a few streets away from the main shopping precinct. There many restaurants and cafes all within walking distance. The room was very clean and there were many thoughtful touches from Paula to make the stay feel very homely. We had a wonderful time !

Very comfortable studio apartment good location n parking hidden behind . 
No iron or board. Great restaurant around the corner called Maria Rita.

Myself and my husband spent a week in Paula’s apt. The location was perfect and close to all amenities. It felt very secure and was quiet at night. 
Our flight was delayed, which meant huge disruption to Paula but she was very understanding. My husband was hospitalized during our trip and Paula was a great support to me, which meant a huge amount. 
I would have no hesitation in recommending Paula’s place. 
Treasa

Very lovely appartment, great central location, many stores/shopping area nearby. Appartement was clean, comfy and with a beautiful balcony - felt like home. Private parking at backyard (car rental company gave us a big car, we managed to get through the gate but next time we would definitely insist to have a smaller one, would have been easier). Perfect place for a short trip or even for a longer stay in beautiful Porto!

It was our first time in Porto, Portugal so we really didn't know what to expect.  This charming apartment was stylish, easily accessible, great location, and Paula was very, very patient with us as we had so many questions.  We would definitely stay again.

Lovely compact modern apartment in a convenient area of Oporto. Stairs to first floor so glad our luggage  wasn’t too heavy.  Our host did carry my case for me. Lovely french windows for a breath of fresh air after to climb up from the river. Kitchen  well equipped although I can’t imagine anyone cooking with all those fabulous restaurants in Oporto. Would definitely return.

Paula's place is small but all you need for your stay. It is conveniently located and has a cute little balcony with table and chairs for your morning coffee. Paula and her mother were accommodating with our arrival time and welcoming.

Das Zimmer von Paula ist sehr gut gelegen. Alles ist zu Fuß erreichbar.
Es gibt einen Kühlschrank, eine Kaffeekapselmaschine und Geschirr. 
Das Zimmer ist sauber und freundlich. Auf dem Balkon ist ein Frühstück gut möglich. 
Check in unproblematisch. Parkplatz nur mit kleinem Auto erreichbar, da die Zufahrt sehr eng ist. 
Preis- Leistungsverhältnis gut.
Il miglior alloggio di sempre
Paula and her sister were very nice! The apartment is cozy and perfectly located for a city trip. Highly recommended!

Paula’s place is in a great location. That being said it does get loud on the streets and in the building. So it depends on what you are looking for. We did have a little bit of difficulty checking in as her mom was late to let us in and we weren’t given instructions as to where to put the keys when we left. Besides this the place was clean and warm and in a nice area.
Unser Aufenthalt bei Paula war super. Das Zimmer ist recht klein, hat aber alles was man braucht. Perfekt, um Zeit in porto zu verbringen. Check-in und Kommunikation waren super. Gerne wieder!
Un typique appartement montréalais chaleureux et confortable.
Endroit propre et acceuillant, mieux que ce à quoi je m'attendais, prêt de tous les services à pied, restaurant et station de métro...etc. Je recommande fortement!!!

We really enjoyed our stay at Richard's place. His apartment was super cozy and had everything you need (good internet, heating, a comfortable bed, clean towels etc.).

We particularly liked how green the apartment was, with a wide array of plants in the living room and kitchen.

It was in a very nice quiet area which was close to nice places to eat and drink. It is also super near a park, which we would have enjoyed in warmer months :)

It was a snowy, rainy and gray few days in Montreal but Richard’s home was a peaceful respite to the foul weather outside. It was a great place to unwind and relax after my busy days at a wine conference. A very homey feel and a lot of charm, sort of the antithesis of slick and modern (which can be a bit soulless.) I didn’t get a chance to meet Richard but he was very responsive to any questions I had and gave me a warm welcome.

Richard’s place is really cozy and sweet. The environment is quite and provides convenient access to supermarket and public transportation. I love the vintage style of this house and all the green inside. A wonderful stay here, Mary Christmas to the hosts!
A very nice place, well located to move around in Montreal. Richard is nice and very reactive. I could only recommend.

The apartment is impeccably tasteful and chic. Even though it’s relatively small and located in an older building, the space is utilized with superb efficiency and sports a huge window that brings in lots of sunlight. The neighborhood is quiet yet close to MTR and tourist attractions. The hosts are friendly and accessible. I wish this was my home!

This is a stylish modernised smart space, good WiFi and it  reaches terrace so you can video call upstairs under the starry night! Hot fab stunning shower. Lots of cupboard space. It rained when I was there but on good day Convenient Walking downhill sheung wan station 10-12 minutes, central station 15-17 minutes. 10 min escalators and 7 min walk straight line into Staunton.  note there are stairs in this part of town. Lots of nice restaurants.  Host kindly left detergent and drying rack for washing. They are very kind and do their best to help you in.

Adorable little flat in a superb location.
Tons of cool bars and restaurants around, very trendy street but also quiet. Terrasse is super cute and although apartment is very tiny (I guess normal size by HK standards!) its very well organized and functional. Might be tricky if you have a lot of luggage as there are quite a few stairs to get up there, but definitely worth it. Thanks to Natalia for being super responsive and letting us check out late. Had a great stay, I hope we can come back soon!

This was the perfect airbnb for our stay in Hong Kong. The space is modern, sparkling clean, and beautifully designed. The building is very centrally located in Sheung Wan but on a quiet street with minimal traffic so you can get a good night’s rest but still walk a few minutes to great cafes, restaurants, and bars. Looks just like the photos and what’s described—it’s small but very well designed. Efficient use of space with a comfortable bed and all modern amenities. Would highly recommend for those interested in minimal design and clean spaces.

Natalia and Paul's stylish apt is located in one of the quaintest neighborhoods in HK. We visited in winter and were able to actually open up the big windows during early mornings and at night to enjoy the fresh air- rare and unlike most of HK, the street below is serene and without much traffic. The interior is clean, modern, and well-appointed. The Nespresso machine is an excellent touch! Natalia and Paul were communicative, and the check-in/out process couldn't be easier.

This place is a true gem of Hong Kong and a wonderfully well-done Airbnb. It is extremely stylish and nice inside, and the space is comfortable and cozy. The apartment is furnished with a hip, modern, clean style.

Out the window is a nice view of the towers of Hong Kong, and upstairs is a great open patio where you can enjoy the surroundings. 

We had no idea when we booked the place that the apartment was located on a very cool street in a unique neighborhood. There are lots of little shops, and our personal favorite: a good beer store just around the corner!

We just can't find enough wonderful things to say about this place. This Airbnb is an amazing find in Hong Kong, and any traveler would surely enjoy it during their stay.

This beautifully and tastefully furnished apartment unit is located in a great location with many stylish bars, cafes, galleries, quaint little shops, and (genuine) old-school HK eateries. Short walk away from Sheung Wan station, it's the perfect base from which to explore HK. Apartment has everything you need, plus some more - the balcony space is an awesome bonus (and we are sad that due to our schedule we couldn't utilise it more). Can't recommend this place enough.

Great stay at Natalia and Paul’s appartment. Great location, nice terrace and stylish and very smart designed studio. Communication with the host went really well and we had a wonderful time. Thank you!
Great location!

Amazing location! Truly one of the best, coolest streets in Hong Kong! Super close to bars and restaurants yet located on a quiet street filled with hip cafes and art galleries. The space itself is very clean and has everything you need for your stay!  Would stay again.

Perfect base for exploring HK, a short walk from almost everything central on Hong Kong Island. Really nicely designed space which, while small is perfectly enough for 2 people traveling light, with everything you would need.

Loved the upstairs roof space, which adds an extra dimension, loved little touches like the nespresso and candles. The bathroom is very small, so just don't expect to fit 2 people in at a time. Highly recommend and likely to re-book. Thanks!
A super location and a wonderful apartment and a lovely rooftop. The communication is perfect and they were very helpful and nice. Would love to stay here again!

The host is responsive and friendly, the listing location is amazing - close to a lot of unique bars, cafes and shops. The space itself is cute, cosy, functional and well designed, would definitely recommend for a short stay!

Stylish, well decorated apartment in the most hip & lively district of HK island. Fast and easy communication.

We were unfortunately unable to take advantage of the brilliant rooftop terrace due to unforeseen weather circumstances...

Warmly recommended!

The location the little, yet lovely flat, is perfect! In an area where everything of interest is close but quiet enough to find peace at night. The rooftop is quite nice for the apéro and the flat is decorated with taste. Very clean and tidy, we found your apartment very confortable. We had a nice stay at your place! We loved the neighborhood, the communication was easy! Cheers!
This flat is a really chic place. There are lots art galleries and fashion shops around it. Very safe and very comfortable to stay there.
在香港这个寸土是金的城市,能找到这个性价比这么好的名宿｡真的很难得｡位置又是在我很喜欢的太平山街,边上有很多特色的店｡家具简约舒服,让我感觉就像在自己家一样｡下次还想再来
I had a wonderful time, the apartment is located in my favorite part of town! Wonderful find. Great fit out and very clean and new feeling. Thanks so much for being so kind with my requests!

The flat is stylish and well decorated. It's quiet area at night. The private rooftop is great for drinks and chill. 
The host is responsive and friendly. 
Highly recommended if you don't mind to walk stairs.

A modern haven away from the hustle and bustle of Hong Kong, Natalia and Paul's space is chic, clean and has everything you need for a stay in HK. The  surrounding art galleries and cafes make this apartment very special. The rooftop is also a fabulous bonus and with the cooler weather this time of year, it was nice to enjoy a bowl of pasta and glass of wine and soak up HK's atmosphere. The hosts were wonderful and very helpful and responsive which made the stay even better. Highly recommend a stay here!

Located perfectly within a stone throw from Soho, amongst art galleries, amazing shopping & excellent restaurants.
Quite, but close to the action
Amazing location and the perfect HK base for a couple. Small but beautifully decorated and cleverly designed. Natalie was quick to respond to all our queries and we really enjoyed our stay!

Lovely studio apartment with a wonderful roof deck in a quiet location with many boutiques, tea rooms, cafes all near Byron Park and only a ten minute walk to Soho’s Peel Street & Staunton Street or ten minute walk to Sheung Wan metro. In all, the perfect place to stay if you like a quiet neighborhood in a central but off the beaten track area of Shanghai.

Yes, Natalia and Paul’s place is tiny, but this was expected. The rooftop space was great and we had some nice times there. Communication was superb. I’d definitely recommend to visitors who want to stay in hip Sheung Wan.

Due to unforeseen circumstances we needed to make other arrangements but Natalia was quick with communications and provided a refund quickly.  I would definitely consider using the accommodation again.

The location is good, there's a lot to see around, tho you need to walk up 4 floors to the room. The host repplied fast enough, tho the light in the bathroom was broken for 3 days for us, just dont really think the place is worth this price cos the roof top area is seldomly used by use and the studio is kinda small.

Thank you Natalia. Smooth conversation before my trip, easy key handover and explanations about the Apartment. The Apartment is neat and clean. However it is indeed small (just as noted in their description), probably not the best to stay if you are above 1.90m tall. And dont underestimate the 4 floor walk-up in this small staircase. Especially if its very hot outside, this makes you sweat even more. 

Overall Id recommend it for a shorter stay, as the Location is really convenient and Natalia is a nice host.
Small but stylish and clean apartment in a lovely, calm neighbourhood. I had a very nice stay and Natalia was very kind in checking in on me once in a while.

such a lovely place in Hong Kong's Sheung Wan . 

cant wait to go back

Natalia and Paul’s studio is a lovely place to stay. It stylish, super clean and in a superb location at the heart of Tai Ping Shan. Communication was very easy, Natalia was kind and helpful. I’d definitely recommend it.

great place! you get what you pay for.  fantastic comfort and cool location.  nice rooftop.  building is old /no elevators but this unit is finely remodeled with great attention to detail.  clean sheets and pillows.  will stay there again
Excellent apartment in a great location which is handy for transport and local amenities. The apartment is small, but is very clean and comfortable. Also has a great roof terrace!
The place is nice and quiet, but also conveniently close to restaurants and shops.

Natalia and Paul’s place was perfect for our stay in HK.
It was very nicely decorated and had everything we needed. The bed was extremely comfortable and the roof terrace was great to sit and have a drink at night.
The apartment is very well located close to many bars, cafes and restaurants and only a short walk from Central.

Our stay was amazing. The apartment is just as described, very stylish, clean, tidy, and very well located - 5 min walk from the buzz of Soho bars, 10 min from Central, in a quiet street. AC, coffee machine, all kitchen supplies, fridge, comfy bed, clean bathroom, clean towels.

Sure there’s a lot of stairs, but you’ve been warned. Just don’t forget things when you leave the apt (like me) and you won’t sweat going up and down 2-3x.

Communication with the hosts was easy, Natalia was very helpful. I stayed for 10 days and she sent a cleaning lady half way through to change the sheets, towels and clean up. Thanks for that. 

All in all, a great place to stay! I’ll come back.
Really cool apt in Sheung Wan and great for a quick biz trip. On the high side of Sheung Wan which is where you want to be. A small apt but stylish and v comfy

Natalia is a very good host. Her apartment is located in a strategic position, very close to the city center and the nightlife, but in a very quiet street. We found it very clean and ordinare and the design is very elegant. I would definitely recommend it to anybody!

A stylish space in a super cool area of Hong Kong, in a traditional walk up building. Great things to see and do, right on the door step and only a short walk to transport links for exploring further out. Highly recommend this spot x

We stayed in this place for 2 weeks and loved it. Easy check in and out with the help of sweet Joanne who also helped us carry our luggage up/down the 4 floors. We used the rooftop terrace a lot in the evenings for drinks and snacks. It’s like the living room since the space in the apartment is quite limited. Walking distance to “everything”. We can really recommend this place if you travel alone or as a couple.
Would love to come back. Thanks Natalia & Paul!
Amazing location and incredible place! Love it and will def stay there again!
房屋装修的很干净整洁,厨具应有尽有(可惜我只住了一天,没有用厨具)｡只是需要爬楼梯,介意或者有大件行李的需要再考虑一下了｡ 其他的一切都好｡

Great spot in Sheung Wan! Central to many neighborhood amenities and easy to access transit. Made for a very easy jumping off point to explore Hong Kong.

Rooftop patio was pleasant but we didn’t use it quite as much as we expected because it was located on the floor above the apartment rather than connected to it.
Great location and great hospitality. Thank you very much for the prompt reply!

Really cute & stylish studio in a fab part of town. Highly recommended for a short Hong Kong visit. 
Also, follow their suggestion of getting a cab with your luggage...    :)

Natalia and Paul’s place is great - well designed and nicely furnished studio right in the middle of super cool Soho, with bars, restaurants, cafes and galleries downstairs and a short walk to the middle of the city.
Great location and super comfy! will definitely stay again.

An amazing location to stay in HK. Very convenient to travel around and plenty of excellent local cafes/restaurants to explore. It is a perfect place for art and food lovers. Unfortunately this trendy little oasis is also a property developers' hotspot. Currently due to all the construction work nearby, it is very noisy and dusty during the day. As long as you stay out most of the time, this nuisance would not affect you.

Overall good place. Great location with lots of nice restaurants, shops, art galleries.

Space is small for the price even by Hong Kong standards... if you plan to use the roof, maybe that’s worth it, but I did not use much since it rained.

Lots of construction noise during the day but fine at night, located on small street.
位置非常便利,去哪里都很方便,附近美食也很多

It’s very rare to find such well-designed and comfy tiny house in HK. You will see Natalia & Paul’s effort on it:) I love it a lot!!! Although it’s a bit far away from mtr station, but it’s located at Tai Ping Shan St. where you’ll find many cool shops and coffee shops nearby. 
However, I believe there’s room of improvement with the roof top, it will be perfect if the cleanliness could be maintained.
The hosts are very friendly and easy to communicate, I hope you guys enjoy the stay there!!

어떻게 수퍼호스트가 됐는지 모르겠음.  
당일 아침까지 확인 메일도 안오고,  체크인 약속시간도 안지켜서 길에서  두시간 기다림. 본사 전회해서야 겨우 연락됨
(어쨌거나 들어갔으니 되지않았냐?) 에어비앤비 직원 반응도 어이없었음. (자주 있는 일??)
---> 다시 가고싶지 않음
Really great place ! Super close to the metro station and many restaurants. Host was amazing with communication and check in was smooth.

On a passé une merveilleuse experience dans l’appart d’emilie. Endroit magnifique avec beaucoup d’espace et un balcon ensoleillé et tranquille. Emilie est très arrangeante. Merci! On reviendra avec plaisir!
Super apart bien placé
Emillie was very kind and hospitable, great stay!
Appartement tranquille, bien situé c'était parfait !
I highly recommend Emilie's place. Its super convenient and 10 min drive to downtown. If you are lucky you can find a parking spot right by her apartment. Its clean and comfy.

Our stay was great! 
Emilie's apartment is the true Montreal experience (I used to live there). The classic walk-up, the original details: hardwood floors and crown mouldings, the quaint balcony to sit and enjoy your morning coffee. Her place is incredibly close to the metro station and the location is incredible, it has all you need for shopping, eating, drinking, sight-seeing, you name it. Emilie was a great host, and it was very easy and quick to communicate. Our check-in was a breeze :)
Clean and cute space in a beautiful location
Le logement est idéalement placé pour visiter Montréal.

Really homey, classic Montreal vibes. Balcony was very enjoyable. The door was a bit of a hassle as well as there was no toilet paper however for the cost it was well worth it! Great location too close enough to pretty much everything but residential enough to find some calm in the city!
Great place, in a great location. Emilie was quick to respond to any questions.
Rapport Qualité prix parfait, appartement bien situé (metro et épicerie à 3-4 min) propre et charment.

Everything was as advertised. Nice, clean, comfortable. We had a very good stay and it it was a very nice base for our exploration of Big Island and preparation and relaxation before and after the Ironman.

Thanx
Dorthe and Jan
A very nice little house and well-equipped. The area is convenient to Hapuna Beach and not very far from north Kohala. The house is unpretentious and fairly comfortable.

We enjoyed a pleasant stay at this cozy home in a very pleasant setting. The location is outstanding - close to Waimea, Hawi, and Kona. The neighborhood is friendly and quiet and feels a bit like old Hawaii. We enjoyed the ocean view and outdoor patio area that allows for great sunset viewing.

Although we did not meet Rachel she communicated with us what we needed to know.the cottage was as it appeared online though some things were a little worn. The location and proximity to sights and beaches was very handy though the neighborhood the house was in was very dense(as in neighbors were very close by)

구글지도가 약간 잘못 알려줘서 처음에 좀 헤멘건 있는데 그거 말고는 아주 좋았습니다.
사진에 보이는 그물침대도 완전 편하고 특히나 침실이3개나 있는게 너무 좋았습니다.

Rachel did a great job of making sure the house was in good condition when we arrived. She was flexible with our early check-in and really made her house feel like a home for us. The house was right off the main road with the a awesome view of the ocean.

Rachel was great host for our week stay on the Big Island. She provided us an interactive map of nearby things to do. 3 miles from Hapuna Beach, 20 minutes from Pololu Valley, 2 minutes from Aloha Cafe for breakfast and about 10 minutes from Big Island Brewhaus for some craft beer and delicious food. The home was a bit difficult to find in the suburb which is nice since it is tucked away from the neighbors. Nice Patio with a hammock to relax after a long day. The house is fully stocked on just about everything from towels to beach chairs to boogy boards. There is 1 a/c unit in the living room which gets cold, the rooms however can get a bit warmer. Fortunately there were fans in each room to cool us down. I would recommend to anyone who is looking for a spot on the north end of the island.

Die Gastgeberin Rachel hat sich sehr gut um uns gekümmert und die Handhabe war sehr unkompliziert. Für unsere Familie war es eine optimale Unterkunft. Die kreative Einrichtung der Wohnung und ihre Ausstattung (Strandutensilien, Grill, Terrasse, etc.) bescherte uns schöne Tage hier. Die nahen Strände eignen sich für kleinere Kinder sehr gut. Für uns alles super!

GREAT LOCATION! Pretty much as close as you can get to the best beaches on the Big Island. Great restaurants are fairly close by. This is PERFECT for a family. It was awesome they had boogie boards and towels ready for us to use. Furniture was a bit older but it doesn't look drastically different than the pictures. No big deal though. Loved staying here. Thank you Rachel.

This is a lovely location to explore the northern end of the island.  Very close to some of the best white sandy beaches, within easy drive of interesting hiking, but far from major grocery stores.   House is a very nice, slightly rustic, patio home in a complex of similar homes.   (Think log cabin instead of ski resort as a winter comparison.)   Full kitchen was small (1 person only!) but very nicely appointed with all pots/pans/etc needed to cook for your vacation with a family-sized gas grill outside so you don't need to turn on the oven.   Washer/Dryer was VERY convenient for our travelling family, too.   Overall, this was a lovely start to our family vacation on the Big Island.
Close drive to Hapuna and other great areas. Rachel was very accommodating with anything that we needed. Would definitely stay again!

This was the perfect place for our family! Close to great beaches, beautiful yard and everything we needed, including geckos and coconuts and bananas that the kids loved finding in the yard! Fabulous stay
Our stay was for one night and Rachel was communicative, and very flexible with our arrival time. Thank you for the stay! Your place felt like a wrinkle in time ;-)
Thank you for sharing your home with us, Rachel! Great location and a good place to sleep. Many amenities including washer/dryer, hairdryer, iron, etc came in handy.

Thanks Rachel for your availibility 
We had a very good time in your house
Exactly what we need

Rachel was very quick in her responses! The photos accurately captured the property. The descriptions were on point. The location was great for us to head to the beach, shopping, dinner, and the airport. There were plenty of amenities but we didn't use much since we were only there for a day. Details like dish soap, towels, boogie boards, and more would be perfect for a longer stay! The air conditioner in the living room was dreamy and an absolute must for those not used to the hotter climate. It can get toasty there. The bedrooms are not air conditioned but there are fans available. The cleaning fee for one day was a bit high but I knew about it and accepted it because I needed a place that held 5 people.

Rachel dialed this experience in for us. She ensured we had the lock box code prior to arrival, immediately answered any questions we sent her way via email, and had all of the windows and doors open to provide us with a nice, cool welcome. There were several things that made our stay especially nice, including body boards, snorkeling fins, a beach cooler and a Brita water filter pitcher. All unexpected and much appreciated!

For those traveling with toddlers, we left our pack 'n play since we didn't want to pay the airline fee on the return flight, so rest assured that you'll have a mobile crib for your little ones at Rachel's place. :)
Great location for Hapuna Beach and Waimea at reasonable price

The house is in a good location - a short drive to 3 great beaches. The house was spacious (there were 3 of us) and is well equipped - bath and beach towels, chairs, a bbq, washer, dryer and indoor and outdoor eating areas. The beds were comfortable. It is a good value - nothing fancy -- but very comfortable. The photos are accurate. Rachael was always available - responded quickly to emails and made our stay easy. We recommend Rachael and this house.

Rachel was a great host and responded quickly to all of our questions. The house is in a perfect area for exploring the island and made a good home-base for our family. There are several towns nearby with stores and restaurants. You can drive to most attractions on the island in a few hours or just hang out on the beaches nearby. The house was clean and had plenty of towels and a nicely stocked kitchen. If you are looking for a luxury packed rental this might not be the spot you are after - but if you are looking for a good deal and plan on exploring the island you could not ask for more.

Rachel's place is great!  We stayed for a week, and loved it.  It has a great view and is perfectly situated to enjoy the Kohala beaches and everything the north end of the island has to offer.  The house itself is small but perfectly set up, with a well equipped kitchen, cute and kitschy Hawaiian decorations, and, of course, that incredible view of the ocean from the patio.

The photos and the description of the place are accurate and the close proximity to the beaches was very convenient for us. We did all of our cooking at home and found most of the things we need available in the kitchen. It is a residential area with Route 19 located right in front of the property so if you are sensitive to noise you might want to bring earplugs for night time.

If you're looking for a local place to stay with a great view and a short drive to the beach, this is IT.  Very reasonably priced. I felt like I lived here and did not want to leave.
5/5 stars.
Great location and value!  If want more local and less resort feel this is a great place.  Couple minor bathroom issues bit otherwise great stay!

My boyfriend and I stayed at Rachel's house while on the Big Island for a wedding. The house is great- clean, lots of room, nice backyard. The kitchen is well stocked and we cooked most of our meals there. There's also a great grill out back and a relaxing hammock. Volcanoes Nat'l Park was about a 2 hours drive. Kona was about 20 minutes away. The house is in a pretty secluded area off the main road, so no walking to stores or restaurants here. We had a great time and would love to stay here again!
Fantastic location to nearby beaches!

We had a great vacation staying here. This place is very conveniently located close to the best beaches in the island and had a very homely feel to it. We loved the garden overlooking the ocean and the host had equipped the kitchen and home with everything we needed which made it very convenient- beach toys, plenty of towels, washer/dryer, a fully equipped kitchen etc. The few things we found slightly less than ideal were
-There were a lot of cockroaches and ants roaming in the kitchen and even in bedrooms at night. This might be a norm in the tropical island.
-The property is adjacent to a very busy freeway and so the garden has a constant traffic noise. The house windows do an excellent job of blocking the noise though so we did not hear anything while indoors.
- There is only one AC in the living room and it takes about 3-4 hours for the bedrooms to cool down in April.
- The garden and the home looks like it needed a bit of tending, though with the fertile land and weather, things probably grow and weather very quickly here.

The house was clean and comfortable with a lovely backyard complete with grill, hammock, table, and even an outdoor sofa.  Dishes, soap, laundry detergent, towels were all provided.  A really nice place to stay.

This is a cute bungalow; not fancy, but comfortable and affordable.  Rachel was a great host and always responded right away.  The view on the back porch is lovely, as is the breeze and lovely aroma of all the tropical plants in the yard. I wished I could take them home with me. The condo is very convenient for the more northern beaches that are less populated, yet were gorgeous. We thoroughly enjoyed snorkeling at Hapuna state park (fabulous beach), the Black sand beach.  We liked the bungalo because it is removed from the big city tourist stuff, and not as uppity as the resorts; yet the drive isn't too bad to get to the Kona beach stuff either, such as a Luau and boat diving trips; but be aware of major delays near the airport until they finish the road construction, so add a half hour to your travel plans that go southward until the road work is finished. The other route across the Island or via Hilo might be best to get to the volcano park for now.

Great location and value for exploring the north end of the island.  Close to Mauna Kea and Hapuna, two very nice beaches.  The house was clean, comfortable, affordable and had everything we needed for a relaxing and enjoyable stay.

This place was perfect for the half ironman race and our group! It was 7 minutes from Hapuna beach where the swim is and not far from fairmont. We had everything we needed to cook, relax outside on the grill or inside with cable. The ac worked well for the common areas. The place had lots of color and charm. It was clean and there were lots of extra towels, beach things to borrow and a washer with clothes line. This was perfect for our group! And a great price!

The apartment was nice. Directions were easy to follow. The window unit really didn't reach back to the furthest two rooms so we had to stay in the smaller bed which was equally fine since it was just two people for two nights. The amenities were very nice and current.

Cute little older style duplex decorated in 60's style. Very comfortable affordable  family accomodation. You Need a car. Close to beautiful Hapuna Beach- we spent 2 days there. We drove to observatory one night- took just over 1 hr. Not close supermarket/cafe. Good to have room to stretch out with kids. Soft sheets and towels. Very Clean. No dishwasher. Shag carpet. Neighbourhood quiet and residential. Good for short stay to check out white beaches.
This place is a decent value.  The host was great in communicating with us and remedying issues when there was a problem.  The inside is clean but dated.

We adored Rachel's place! Centrally located, you are just a short drive from countless beaches and resorts on the coast, and just 15 minutes from Waimea for groceries and restaurants. We loved this house as our home base for a wedding at Hapuna and exploring the whole island. The hammock, outdoor area, grill, and great kitchen make this the best deal on the island! 

Definitely rent a car, you will want to explore the whole island!
Cute bungalow, but noisy due to the nearby road. Not easy to get the bedrooms cooled. Nonetheless, we liked our stay because of the proximity to some stunning beaches and to the north.
Great place to stay!

This place is great! Three bedrooms with very comfortable beds. Great location overlooking the ocean. It’s up a ways from the Kona area but in a great location to see the island as everything is a reasonable driving distance. You will need a vehicle to get around the island and a parking spot right outside is available!

Comfortable and cozy house near some great beaches. Really enjoyed our stay and wish we could have stayed longer. Rachel and Debbie were great hosts and provided a great website with helpful local tips.

Rachel's place was truly amazing. I felt like I was walking into my 2nd home. The views are gorgeous and yet it's nestled away from the big hotels so you get the local experience. It was so peaceful and comfortable. The place is very spacious and would be great for a family or group of friends. I would absolutely stay there again. The back room on the right has a bed that's like sleeping on a cloud. Rachel gave very detailed directions that helped a lot for someone new to Hawaii. Rachel and Debbie were both readily available if I needed anything at all and I am so thankful.
Very comfortable space, decorated in a Beach type theme. The place is outfitted with just about anything you might need.
Nice, comfortable, and clean house.

We absolutely loved the place.  It has a very different from atmosphere from a resort, or central tourist areas. It's old Hawaii. Nearby beaches are top notch, snorkeling is fab, you can eat on a patio under the stars, and  the fact that the house is not far from a freeway and a part of a village just adds charm and a sense of realness.  The selection of places in Rachel's guide is right on, kitchen has everything needed to cook (not groceries, I mean amenities), boogies, beach chairs, beach mats, towels, etc. - all clean and ready. We are coming back!

We felt like we were staying at our Hawaiian grandma’s house! While a bit dated, the house was spotless and well stocked with absolutely everything we needed for our beach adventures. The only drawback was the noise from the highway- it was pretty loud, but we knew that going in and it was worth it for the super close proximity to amazing beaches and great food.
Great location.

Great value!  Location only a minute or two from Hapuna beach, restaurants, gas, and grocery stores.  Also a short drive into Hawi, Kailua, and Waimea.  We had a great time doing the flume tour, and walking in Kailua as,well.  You made our vacation affordable.  Thank you so much.

Our family of four: mom, dad and an eight year old boy and 10 year old girl spent two nights at Rachel's house. If you have a car, then this is a fabulous place to stay for relaxing days at the beach. Spencer Beach is just down the hill-5 minute drive. Hapuna Beach is a little further-maybe 15 minutes-but so worth it-one of the nicest beaches we have ever been to. Make sure you do your grocery shopping on the way, either in Waimea if coming from that direction, or Kailua-Kona, because there is nothing nearby. The listing is clear that there is car and truck noise from the road. This is true. But it is the only noise. Otherwise it is very quiet and peaceful. There is less traffic after 9:30pm and it only starts again around 5am. We slept with the windows open for a breeze and I closed them and turned on the a/c when the traffic started at dawn. The a/c really mutes the noise. I am a very light sleeper and I slept fine. The garden is quite big, the kids had fun playing in it. There is a hose out back to rinse off feet and beach stuff. The decor is pretty, it has a very hawaiian beach vibe. The beds are very comfortable, we slept very well. The shower has good water pressure. We recommend this place, just don't expect to eat out in restaurants or pick something up. Be prepared and you will have a relaxing time.

Rachel's place was great and she was very responsive and accommodating. It has a great Hawaiian vibe to the decoration and a spacious outdoor area that we wish we could have hung out in more. Rachel's place was in a great location with excellent beaches nearby (10 min drive), Kona was accessible (about 25 min drive), Waimea was close enough to go to dinner (20 mins), and there is a delicious shave ice window just up the road (5 min North).
This is a quaint, very clean, quiet accommodation with a fantastic location.

Rachel's place is fantastically located within a very short drive to all the big island's best beaches. Her place is comfortable, clean, and delightfully decorated with beach charm giving it the tropical island vibe. It had everything we needed along with fun beach gear to use. I would definitely recommend her place!!

Rachel was very kind and communicative before the trip. The unit is in a convenient location to explore Hapuna and the Kohala area. It is a very short drive to Hapuna beach and a relatively short drive to Waimea which had good grocery and restaurant options. All amenities listed were present including fully stocked kitchen and bathroom. Unfortunately, we were surprised by the condition of the unit. It is an older unit which has not been updated and the overall condition was not accurately represented in the photos.  The highway noise is quite loud. If the pictures had been more accurate, we would probably have chosen another airbnb for our stay.

The place is at prime and private location next to best beaches on the Big Island. Family who would stay will find all necessary and in clean condition. Safe and well maintained. If come to Big Island again we will definitely try to stay there again.  Mahalo.
A good location and host responds fast. However, this place really needs to be updated. The pictures are just not a very accurate depiction of the place.
Great location and an even better rate than the rest of the accommodations close by.

Rachel's home is a great place to stay especially if you prefer a real person's home compared to more luxurious but sterile condominium locations. Artwork throughout home was especially appealing. Rachel is very prompt and responsible about communications and helped us with having an earlier check-in. Hapuna Beach and Spencer Beach are great and very short drives from the home. Potential downside is having only one bathroom, but it was not a problem for our family of four.
Very well cleaned and plenty of sleeping space for everyone. Space is a little dated but the value is very good. Very close to Spencer Beach and Hapuna Beach.

We thoroughly enjoyed our week stay at Rachel’s cute beach house. The ocean view is gorgeous and it’s just minutes away from my favorite beach Hapuna. She is more then accommodating, The house is stocked with everything you need. Definitely recommend!!

Rachel’s place was the perfect family hale! Very inviting, we loved all of the colors, decor and character Rachel’s place has to offer!  The hammock offers breathtaking views to just relax after a fun filled day near Hawaii’s most beautiful beaches. Rachel is very quick in responding and goes above and beyond in hosting! Highly recommended Airbnb!

We were comfortable at this house, except that during the day the weather was hot but air conditioner is only in the living room. It is an old house, so there is wear and tare. It is comfortable and clean. Great outdoor space. It’s next to the main road, but noise did not bother us. The kitchen is old as well as some appliances so I was not inspired to cook much, only simple meals for kids. Liked spending time on outdoor patio backyard. The proximity to the great beaches and Waimea I liked a lot. Not sure it’s a best value for money though.
Lovely island flair and living

I imagine this place will be difficult to book so book now! The value is tremendous due to it's location, size and price. I am so grateful to have had the opportunity to book this place. It was nearly perfect.
Nice decor with Hawaiian feel. Space is a little bit tight though for group of 6.

Very hot with no curtains and AC only in living room, my parents and I had to leave immediately after arriving due to extreme heat. Not so nice after a whole day of driving. Remained hot the entire time in bedrooms, even at night with fans on and windows open. Right next to highway, very loud at all times. Not worth the amount we paid for it. Very outdated place.
We had a great time here! We recommend :)

Six of us stayed here. There was plenty of space for all of us. The beds were comfortable and space was nice. The kids loved the hammock outside. We had a great time, easy to relax and enjoy ourselves.
Rachel had some great recommendations of things to see and do, and was very easy to contact.
There is some road noise, but that was expected with the location, right next to the highway. Location also made it extremely easy to get to places. As well, there are great public beaches a few minutes away.

All in all we enjoyed our stay at Rachel's place. Close to some of my favorite beaches. There is no TV unless you have a computer with Netflix. They do have wifi. House is vintage as described and could use a little update on ceiling fans,  a Bluetooth speaker ( since no TV, music would be nice, and the stereo/ radio in bedroom is barely working. ) Old beds~ but nice sheets and mattress toppers! And shag carpet is definitely old and really should be replaced with flooring. Just my opinion.  And be prepared with earplugs....the road noise can definitely be heard as the home sits just above the highway. Rachel is a great host and quick to respond to any questions or needs. Thank you Rachel.
The view from the  back yard is  amazing.  We could  see wales. The location is  excellent,  a short  drive to  Spencer beach and  not too far to Waimea

If your expectations for accommodations are low, and considering that you are visiting Hawaii, not a third world country, and you don't mind staying in a poorly maintained property, you won't be disappointed.  We knew this home was not a luxury property but luxury has nothing to do with proper maintenance of a rental home.  AirBnB standard is to make the renters feel at home while staying at an AirBnB.  This was certainly not the case at this location.  We are not aware if there is an updated quality inspection from AirBnB
The condo is situated close to the main roads for the area making it easy to go anywhere on the northern part of the island.

Rachel's place was great. As advertised, it's not fancy or modern but had 3 bedrooms, bathroom and kitchen. we really enjoyed our stay. the location was great. view from the patio was awesome. only 3 minutes from the best beach on the island. I would stay here again.  Great price for the location.
The host canceled this reservation 7 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

This studio is really really well located, comfortable and well equipped. I needed to spend a night away from home running around Montreal, and being on the cusp of downtown and the plateau made it easy for me to reach most places I needed to go on foot. Saint Laurent is right around the corner too. Tarek is a friendly and funny guy, and was easy to coordinate with (he actually checked me in personally at 11pm). Oh, and the bed has been replaced by a full one! Definitely would recommend this place to tourists who want a cosy space and central location.

My husband and I had a great time staying at this studio for our daughters graduation. The location is one block away from McGill Downtown campus. The host was very kind to help us find free parking right next to the house upon arrival. The facade of the house looks like a heritage site, very beautiful. The studio has all new facilities, the bathroom is large for a studio and fully renovated. Kitchen is nice, it also had some breakfast items. This place is great for a couple. The only downside is the mattress, not the most comfortable. Otherwise an A+ place and host. Would highly recommend.

We absolutely loved staying at Tarek's charming place which is just how he described it -- a cozy ground floor studio condo that is perfectly situated. We were just steps from the scenic McGill University, a short walk to the vibrants bars & restaurants on St-Laurent Street, and were conveniently able to walk to many other places during our stay. The exterior of the building is beautiful and historical looking while the interior is updated, comfortable, and super clean... all while being very peaceful and serene when we needed a break from sightseeing. 

Tarek was a superb host -- he was very kind and communicative with us from the get-go and was flexible to some logistical issues we had. He even gave us "must-see" and "must-eat" tips and overall made us feel very welcome on our first visit to Montreal. We would definitely stay here again in the future. Highly recommend!

We had a great experience staying at Tarek's apartment.  It was very clean and spacious for a studio, and the location was fantastic.  We hit quite a bit of unexpected traffic and were about an hour and a half late arriving, and he was extremely accommodating for us.  He helped us find parking, and was available for questions throughout our stay.  Check out was a bit cumbersome because of an unforeseen conflict, but Tarek was very accommodating to make it as easy as possible for us.

We had a really nice stay at Tarek's place. The room is very clean and cozy. Location is perfect too. It is close to McGill University and few minute walk from rue St Laurent. Bus stop is just around the corner too. Tarek is also an amazing host and really accommodating. Would highly recommend!

My fiancé and I arrived on a Thursday afternoon. Tarek met and welcomed us kindly. He showed us the apartment and even gave us some local restaurants and areas we should visit during our week long stay. He was an excellent host. When I reached out with a couple of questions, he responded even though he was away on vacation. The apartment is perfect for a couple looking to spend quality time together. It's cozy, clean and more than I expected for a studio apartment. I would return here without a question. Thank you Tarek!
I enjoyed my stay in this place. it is clean, neat, and we furnished. The host is very helpful and responsive. it is close to downtown and very quite.

Tarek was very helpful and flexible regarding our check in and check out.  We came an hour later than we had expected (as our train was delayed) and he was very understanding.   We were three adults staying for three nights, and although the place is set up for one or two adults, Tarek provided us with an inflatable mattress, and things worked out fine.  The place is nice, fully renovated, and very well located, in the heart of McGill Ghetto.  It's very lively with all the students setting up for the school year.  There are a lot of ammenities close by and the location is quite central.  Overall, a very nice stay.

My girlfriend and I stayed at Tarek's place for a weekend trip to Montreal. Tarek was an extremely gracious, communicative, and accommodating host. His place is clean, cozy, and very comfortable (the bed is a dream). The apartment is in a superb location: convenient to public parking garages, close to more delicious restaurants and cafes and bars than I can count, only a 20-minute walk from the Museum of Fine Arts, and just a little longer to the Old Port and Notre-Dame Basilica. Our only regret is that we didn't stay longer!

Everything about Tarek's place was great.  Perfect location for checking out Montreal.  He was informative about what to eat/visit/check out and I would absolutely recommend this place to others.  A nice quiet apartment, very close to St/ Laurent!

Tarek was extremely accommodating. When we arrived in Montreal, was about to rain really hard for hours upon hours -- so Tarek arranged to meet us earlier to give us the keys. He also left us some breakfast items. 

The apartment was very clean. Great location. Couldn't have been happier.

My girlfriend and I stayed in this condo for a few nights on a holiday to Montreal, and it was exactly what we needed. The condo itself is fully self contained and in a fantastic location to explore every corner of the city. Tarek was a great host, being very accommodating for late check ins and early check outs, while also recommending some delicious restaurants. The bathroom and kitchen were both very clean in good condition. I'd definitely recommend this condo to anyone, and we will definitely look to stay here again when we next come to Montreal!
Tarek's place is great! Great location, super clean, and Tarek was easy to reach and very accommodating. Would definitely stay again!
Very close to McGill.  A wonderful stay!
This place is very close to McGill University and also very practical to visit the city. A Great place to stay, with all you need to feel like home !

You'll find this place just as expected - charming, clean and in a great location. Separate side door entry is very convenient and the place itself is pretty well maintained. Tarek was easy to communicate with and a gracious host. We were very happy with our short stay here as we explored Montreal!
